raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add RedHatAI quantized checkpoint variants to seven existing model recipes.

## Claims

- Covers DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Muse-Glimmer-30B, Phi-4-reasoning, Kimi-K3, Whisper-large-v3, Laguna-S-2.1, and Inkling.
- Leaves existing defaults unchanged and records hardware restrictions and unverified VRAM estimates.

## Validation

Validation is pending; this PR is intentionally a draft.

- Passed: `git diff --check`.
- Planned source validation (not run): from `/home/Roderick-Wu/recipes`, run `pnpm install` if dependencies are missing, then:
  `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /home/Roderick-Wu/recipe-worktrees/other-quantized/recipes`
- Planned serving smoke test (not run): use the generated command for H100-compatible entries on the 8xH100 node; check `/v1/models` and send a short `/v1/chat/completions` request. Blackwell-only variants and Kimi-K3's estimated memory footprint need separate hardware consideration.

## Details

The Kimi-K3 INT4 addition is separate from [#64586](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64586), which updates environment settings, and [#62668](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62668), which adds Ascend profiles. AI assistance was used to prepare this change.

---

<details>
<summary>Pull Request Checklist</summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] Design Fit: confines changes to existing recipe files and preserves defaults.
- [ ] Testing and Validation: pending author validation.
- [x] Code Quality and Style: `git diff --check` passed.
- [x] Pull Request Contents: documents hardware limits, estimates, and related PRs.
</details>
